title: Juicy Cozy Thai Barramundi Stir-fry
description: A floral, juicy, cozy Thai dish featuring barramundi with a touch of tandoor spices that complements the halal-friendly meal.
instructions: Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C). Season barramundi with tandoori masala and garlic.
In a separate bowl, mix lime juice, chopped Thai basil leaves, minced garlic cloves, ginger slices, and red bell pepper.
Place the seasoned barramundi on a baking sheet. Drizzle over the marinade mixture evenly.
Bake in preheated oven for 20 minutes or until fish is fully cooked and flakes easily with a fork.
Sauté the red bell pepper and basil leaves gently until fragrant, adding to the dish just before serving.
